title: Fourth-moment measure condition
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a measurable space, let $\mu$ be a measure on it, let $B\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The measure and function satisfy the stated fourth-moment condition when $\int X^4\,d\mu\le B\left(\int X^2\,d\mu\right)^2$.
